title: Count Connected Subgraphs with Even Node Sum
goal: Solve Count Connected Subgraphs with Even Node Sum: Enumerate induced node subsets, reject odd sums, and traverse retained edges to prove connectivity.
strategy: Enumerate induced node subsets, reject odd sums, and traverse retained edges to prove connectivity.

phasePurposes.select: Keep the subset and its induced edges.
phasePurposes.done: Return the count over all non-empty subsets.

edgeCases: Only nonempty connected selected subgraphs with even node-value sum count; an even sum alone is insufficient.
inputRules: Enter {"nums":[0,1],"edges":[[0,1]]}: 1–13 binary node values and distinct undirected edges.
Each edge must be a unique [u,v] with 0 ≤ u < v < nums.length.
